prologue.title: Prologue — The Spindle
prologue.d01: In Aurelia, every child learns the empire's story from a vase. The Augural College has them painted, and the augurs recite them at festivals.
prologue.vase.hint: Turn the vase: drag with the mouse, or use the arrows. Space moves to the next face.
prologue.vase.speaker: An augur of the College
prologue.face.city: Aurelia, the golden city, which gathered the peoples under one law, and the gods of every people under one sky.
prologue.face.flame: At its heart, the Flame of Vesta. As long as it burns, the order of the world will not come undone.
prologue.face.monster: Beneath the earth, the labyrinth, and in it the monster our courage locked away. It does not come out. No one goes in.
prologue.face.vestals: And the Vestals, who never leave the flame alone. Because of them, the city sleeps in peace. So it was, so it is, so it shall be.
prologue.d02: But behind every painting there is the hand that painted it. And behind every life, a thread.
prologue.threads.hint: Drag one thread onto another to tie them. Sweep the blade across a thread to cut it. Space: leave them as they are.
prologue.threads.ghost: The hand passes through this thread, as if it had already been cut.
prologue.m_threads.none: Left the threads as they were
prologue.d_tie: The knot holds. Two threads that have never met begin to pull at each other.
prologue.d_cut: The loose thread falls. Somewhere, someone forgets why they were afraid.
prologue.d_none: The threads stay as they were. Leaving them is a choice too.
prologue.d03: Every choice in this story becomes a thread like these: tied, cut or tangled. None of them is the right one. All of them have a price.
prologue.d04: In the Temple, with no wind at all, the flame bends for a moment. No one sees. Almost no one.
